goalSummary: The code-graph-rag MCP server fails to reach codegraph functionality when the container isn't running or its persisted index data is missing.

facts.why: Runbook must name the exact Dockerfile defining the containerized codegraph service
The exact package name that must run containerized (not globally installed) must be stated
Fix: codegraph must not be installed globally on the host, only container-only
The install.sh constant wiring container lifecycle must be identified
The repository-committed persistence directory for SQLite/FTS5 artifacts must be documented
